data.turoyo: Bəṯr fayət waxt ġalabe biya, u malko dab Bəzantiye Anastas laǧan u əkram di xaṭəraṯe bi dukṯo di maʕbadaṯe masəmle i ʕito, d kəmbaḥasno mena.
data.translation: Dann verging darüber viel Zeit. Anastas, der König der Byzantiner, ließ zur Ehrung dieses Andenkens an Stelle dieser Stätte der Gottesverehrung die Kirche erbauen, von der ich spreche.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell, pronominal m-topic in a self-contained church-building statement.

data.turoyo: Harke kubaʕno, d umanno hano ste: lə mbaḥasli m ġalabe qəryawoṯo ḥrene, d fayitina aʕlayye w ḥzallan, xəd Bote, ʕərnəs, Aḥlaḥ w Sayra.
data.translation: Ich möchte hier bemerken, daß ich von vielen anderen Dörfern, durch die wir gekommen sind und die wir gesehen haben, nicht gesprochen habe, wie Bote (Bate), ʔirnis, Ahlah und so weiter.

data.turoyo: Ḥəngi d maʕəǧbole, lo mbaḥasle, b mən maqṣad aṯi su babo di kačke.
data.translation: Da sie ihm sehr gefiel, redete er gar nicht davon, warum er zu dem Vater des Mädchens gekommen war.

summary: Active topic government varies: m- NP or suffix, zero-marked topic (pumpkin dish), ʕal- books, and indirect clausal content. These do not require different numbered speech senses.

The inherited Detransitive example is a negative impersonal evaluation with m-topic and lqul comparison standard. Its gloss is supplied directly; a generic 'be discussed' Detransitive is not independently attested here.
Preterit-wa has -wa plus L-agent suffixes, including 2sg.f mbaḥəswoləx. The disfluent book passage does not settle the immediate agent from Turoyo alone.

The inherited Preterit example quotes the place-description wording of 4/51 while also citing 11/172. The supplied 11/172 instead has negative discussion of unmentioned villages. Keep the inherited text and flag the reference mismatch, adding the distinct negative passage.
No Idiomatic phrases added. The evaluative construction is already represented in the Detransitive section, and the borrowed verb is not itself a light-verb-plus-noun phrase.
Is negative mibaḥəs mene lqul a fixed evaluative construction or a productive 'not worth mentioning' comparison? This affects conventionality, not the supplied example's comparative interpretation.
Check the extra 11/172 reference attached to bḥs.II.t.preterit.1: the source here differs from its quoted 4/51 text. Remove or relocate that reference only after the edition concordance is verified.
Talay 2/15: resolve Shabo versus bishop as immediate agent; preserve the edition's wording without using it to establish suffix reference.
